---
title: "A: text: holding a raw-HTML fenced block"
include-in-header:
  text: |
    ```{=html}
    <style type="text/css">
      .marker-a { color: rebeccapurple; }
    </style>
    ```
---

The `<style>` block never reaches the output, and the warning blames
the include *form* rather than the value's shape.
